course.delete_body: This removes the course and every module, lecture and problem in it, together with students' submissions and scores. To stop teaching it without losing work, hide it instead.

class.delete_body: This removes the class, its roster and its schedule. Refused if any student has submitted through it — archive it instead.

student_work.heading: Student work will be deleted too
student_work.count_one: {{count}} submission {{from}}, with its score and feedback
student_work.count_other: {{count}} submissions {{from}}, with their scores and feedback
student_work.check_failed: Could not check for student submissions. Deleting still removes any there are.
